status: Native source-order and complete-body proof; whole audio.dll remains incomplete.
change: Replace the 16 forward inline ClampAudioSample calls in four scalar envelope functions with equivalent ordinary local integer saturation statements. The standalone helper and its later command-mixer calls remain in native order.
reason: VC7 defers callers of a later-defined inline helper until the end of the translation unit. Explicit saturation statements emit these four functions where they appear in source and reproduce their original algorithm without linker ordering directives.
source_form_evidence: All 35 function bodies in the grouped unit are byte-for-byte unchanged before relocation; all 14 envelope contributions retain exact original bytes and verified targets.
Explicit sample clamps also occur in the recovered integer mixer family and archived UltraHLE SLIST.C. Exact original names and file boundaries remain inferred.
No instruction embedding, code patching, synthetic padding, or linker /ORDER was used.

regression.linker_alignment_note: The four SIMD COFF contributions exclude 26 bytes of following native linker alignment. Their placement remains part of the complete DLL comparison.

symbol.name: $T75412
symbol.address_evidence: Unique complete 12-byte SEH scope table after resolving both internal labels in the unchanged, exact AudioOSHasSSE body; see analysis/audio-envelope-order.json.

negative_controls.remove_inline_forward_declaration: All bodies still match, but the four scalar callers remain deferred.
negative_controls.ternary_clamp_expression: Restores order but mismatches two scalar bodies.
negative_controls.lower_limit_first_if_else: Restores order but mismatches all four scalar bodies.
